description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDecorator class, which decorates the PerformanceReview entity by providing additional methods to retrieve related data, format date fields, and determine review status. It also includes traits for entity management and date-time helper functions.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the PerformanceReview entity providing additional methods for accessing related entities, formatting date fields, and determining review statuses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceReview object.

methods.name: getPerformanceReview
methods.description: Returns the PerformanceReview object being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the performance review by employee number.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the job title associated with the performance review by job title ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who is the supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who is the employee.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted due date of the performance review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the review period.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted completion date of the review.

methods.name: getStatusName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the performance review's status.
